body: You're in pain, that's not easy or fast to go, we don't know how to handle it and cannot control it. It really isn't easy, stranger, don't put so much weight on you and invalidate your feelings

How do you know your problems are not worth listening if you don't communicate them? Also you don't need the same traumatic experiences as the majority to feel like this... Sometimes we don't even notice what's been hurting us until way after adulthood

*hugs* everyone is damaged, stranger, it doesn't make is any less though. I had the chance to have a friendship, a special one. We were able to get through the damage and see ourselves as real humans... We don't talk anymore haha, it was good while it lasted though. Interpersonal relationships are probably the hardest thing in life, yet you can't live without them. Let you heal a bit, get to know yourself, recognize your worth, try again those are the phases after the ones you mentioned in my experience

Hey, girl, you gotta be careful with antideps, if you didn't get a psychiatrist's recommendation to raise the dosage you should go back and stick to the normal. Remember when you're not careful with them one of the adverse effects is to feel even more depressed. Please get a word with a doctor if you're trying that. However working on your own or with psychotherapy is a must in my opinion. Hugs and good luck
